description: Pins the comprehensive-review skill against the failure modes called out in evaluations/bad-review.md and the shape laid out in evaluations/good-review.md.
model_hint: Any modern instruction-following LLM. Tested informally against Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-4o.

tests.description: A 'looks good, nothing to add' style response is the canonical failure mode; the skill must surface concrete observations instead.
tests.input: Please review this PR description: 'Adds rate limiting to /api/users. LGTM, nothing to add.'

tests.description: Sprawling 'rewrite the whole thing as hexagonal architecture' suggestions are out-of-scope and the skill must keep the review actionable for the current diff.
tests.input: Review this PR: it adds a 30-line function that validates a date string. The reviewer is tempted to suggest rewriting the entire validation layer.

tests.description: Speculation without a specific reference is a soft-failure pattern; assertions about memory, perf, or correctness must point at a file/line/function.
tests.input: Review this PR: it adds a Map<string, number> that grows for the lifetime of the process. Decide whether to flag a memory concern.

tests.description: If the diff touches tests, the review must comment on the tests; tests-as-implementation are a common review blind spot.
tests.input: Review this PR: it adds a new function plus two unit tests that exercise only the happy path.

tests.description: Reviews that catch only formatting (extra newline, indentation) when the diff has real design content should be flagged.
tests.input: Review this PR: 'Looks good. Nit: extra blank line at the end of handler.ts. Approve.' The diff itself adds a 200-line authentication module.
